ExplorerProfile.title: ExplorerProfile
ExplorerProfile.description: Represents a profile for an explorer in the Multiverse Explorer application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ExplorerProfile entity (Firebase UID).

name.description: The given name of the explorer.

identificationName.description: The unique identification name chosen by the explorer across the multiverse.

purpose.description: The explorer's stated purpose or mission within the multiverse.

story.description: The personal history or background story of the explorer.

universeName.description: The name of the universe the explorer wants to create.

ndi.description: Unique Identification Number (NDI) following the pattern 4872173 - x.

profileImageUrl.description: The URL to the explorer's profile image.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the explorer profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the explorer profile was last updated.

definition.description: Stores individual explorer profiles indexed by their User UID.

params.name: explorerProfileId
params.description: The unique identifier for the explorer profile (UID).
